items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer asks 'when were you with Claudet Hopkins?' but the interviewee does not answer this question or mention Claudet Hopkins in their response, instead discussing Fats Navarro and working in New York.

ctx.x: Yeah, now when were you with Claudet Hopkins? How did that come about?
Fats went to Europe, and one of those times he went to Europe, two or three times --
